source: Necessary preparations ought to be made—but of course, there is little use in me making them, as I owe the court nothing further.
target: 临走前总该做些安排——不过，我已不欠宫廷什么了，再由我来操办，也没什么意义。

source: Polonius: Then we shall depart as soon as possible. Polonius: Necessary preparations ought to be made—but of course, there is little use in me making them, as I owe the court nothing further. Laertes: Let us gather our belongings, Father. I'll have Reynaldo staff a carriage.
target: 波洛涅斯: 那我们就尽快启程。 波洛涅斯: 临走前总该做些安排——不过，我已不欠宫廷什么了，再由我来操办，也没什么意义。 雷欧提斯: 我们收拾行李吧，父亲。我会让雷纳尔多为马车安排人手。
